description: Feature list — the harness primitive. Each item has the triple: behavior + verification + state. Only one feature may be ACTIVE at a time. Transition to PASSING requires verification exit 0 + human sign-off.

features.name: Deterministic Build A implementation
features.behavior: After recorded human approval, reviewed synthetic fixtures flow through validate → normalize → deterministic route → exactly one minimal local result, with terminal outcomes APPROVED/REJECTED/PENDING_REVIEW and no prohibited effect.
features.evidence: 2026-08-04: ./init.sh clean PASS (exit 0) && python3 -m pytest tests claims/tests -v => 38 passed (19 retained core unchanged + 19 claims incl. runner). Stdlib-only; no network/provider/subprocess imports in claims/. All three terminal outcomes exercised; determinism + fail-closed writer proven. Fix #1: claims_runner bound to real claims/runner.py; demo/claims_demo.py shows gate DENY (phase-01 unsigned) then ALLOW (post sign-off) running the REAL runner. Routing rule (covered<submitted=>REJECTED, covered>submitted=>PENDING_REVIEW, exact=>APPROVED) human-confirmed. Human sign-off recorded 2026-08-04.

features.name: Build A evaluation and snapshot

features.name: Build C — LLM extraction front-end
features.behavior: An extract() stage turns raw email text into a claim record dict via a Bedrock small/fast model (minimal SDK, IAM-role creds), which flows UNCHANGED through validate -> normalize -> route -> write. The LLM proposes; the deterministic router disposes. Malformed extraction -> PENDING_REVIEW; the coverage amount comes from a trusted policy lookup, never the email. Authorized by the Build C amendment in Context/claims-architecture.md.
features.verification: ./init.sh && python3 -m pytest tests claims/tests extraction/tests -v && python3 evaluation/eval.py --snapshot evaluation/build-c
features.evidence: Phase opened 2026-08-04 (human 'yes' + Build C amendment signed). Decisions: Bedrock IAM-role / small-fast model / minimal raw SDK. GATING PREREQUISITE before any extractor code or egress: data-processing/compliance review (PII crosses to provider). egress_hosts stays [] until that review passes.
